text_en: They therefore sent messengers to him to sue for peace in these words:
text_cn: 他们遂派遣使者同他商谈和平说：

text_en: “We, the servants of Nebuchadnezzar, the Great King, lie prostrate before you. Do with us whatever you will.
text_cn: “看，我们是拿步高大王的奴仆，俯伏在你面前，你看怎样好，就怎样处置我们罢！

text_en: See, our buildings and all our land and all our wheat fields and our flocks and herds and all our encampments lie before you; do with them as you please.
text_cn: 看，我们的住宅、所有的土地和麦田，以及羊群牛群，帐幕旁所有的羊圈，都摆在你面前，你可任意取用。

text_en: Our towns and their inhabitants are also your slaves; come and deal with them as you see fit. ”
text_cn: 看，我们的城与城中的居民，都是你的奴仆，你来，看着怎样好，就怎样对待他们罢！”

text_en: The men came to Holofernes and told him all this.
text_cn: 使者来到敖罗斐乃前，就向他说了这些话。

text_en: Then he went down to the seacoast with his army and stationed garrisons in the fortified towns and took picked men from them as auxiliaries.
text_cn: 他便同他的军队，下到沿海一带，派兵据守设防的城，又在他们中选拔壮丁，作后备兵。

text_en: These people and all in the countryside welcomed him with garlands and dances and tambourines.
text_cn: 城中的居民，及其附近境内的人民，都带着花冠，跳着舞，敲着鼓，出来迎接他。

text_en: Yet he demolished all their shrines and cut down their sacred groves; for he had been commissioned to destroy all the gods of the land, so that all nations should worship Nebuchadnezzar alone, and that all their dialects and tribes should call upon him as a god.
text_cn: 但是，他还是要破坏他们的圣地，砍伐他们的神林，因为他曾受命，要铲除地上所有的神祇（qí），使万国一致崇拜拿步高一人，万民异口同声称他为神。

text_en: Then he came toward Esdraelon, near Dothan, facing the great ridge of Judea;
text_cn: 随后来到厄斯得隆对面，即犹太平原前的多堂附近，

text_en: he camped between Geba and Scythopolis, and remained for a whole month in order to collect all the supplies for his army.
text_cn: 安营在革巴与史托颇里之间， 在那里驻扎了一个月，为把自己部队的辎重集合起来。
